---
title: "CDI Scoring"
---

Generate percentile scores for your own CDI administrations, for the major
sections of the English (American) and Spanish (Mexican) *Words & Gestures*
and *Words & Sentences* forms. Upload a CSV with columns for child ID, age
in months, sex (optional), and any summary scores — **your file is processed
entirely in your browser and never uploaded anywhere.**

{{< include components/_filters.qmd >}}
{{< include components/_download.qmd >}}
{{< include components/_style.qmd >}}

```{ojs setup-scoring}
//| output: false
Plot = import("https://esm.sh/@observablehq/plot@0.6.17")
d3 = require("d3@7")

norms = d3.json("resources/scoring/norms.json")
norms_meta = d3.json("resources/scoring/norms_meta.json")
samples = ({
  ws: await d3.csv("resources/scoring/sample_ws.csv", d3.autoType),
  wg: await d3.csv("resources/scoring/sample_wg.csv", d3.autoType)
})

// column auto-guessing per measure
measure_guesses = ({
  prod: ["produced", "production", "prod", "vocab", "words_produced", "vocab_nwords"],
  comp: ["understood", "comprehension", "comp", "words_understood"],
  earlygest: ["early_gestures", "earlygest", "early_gest"],
  lategest: ["late_gestures", "lategest", "late_gest"],
  totgest: ["total_gestures", "totgest", "tot_gest"],
  phrases: ["phrases", "phrases_understood"],
  wordend2: ["word_endings", "wordend", "wordendings"],
  wordforms: ["word_forms", "wordforms"],
  complex: ["complexity", "complex"],
  M3L: ["m3l", "mlu", "mean_length"]
})
static_guesses = ({
  id: ["subject_id", "subid", "id", "child_id"],
  age: ["age", "age_months", "months"],
  sex: ["sex", "gender"]
})
guess_col = (cands, cols) =>
  cols.find((c) => cands.includes(c.toLowerCase())) ?? ""
```

:::: {.viz-layout}

::: {.viz-sidebar}

```{ojs inputs-instrument-sc}
viewof sc_lang = Inputs.select(
  new Map(Object.entries(norms_meta.labels.language).map(([v, l]) => [l, v])),
  { label: "Language" }
)
viewof sc_form = Inputs.select(
  new Map(Object.entries(norms_meta.labels.form)
    .filter(([v]) => norms[sc_lang]?.[v])
    .map(([v, l]) => [l, v])),
  { label: "Form" }
)
viewof use_sample = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Use sample data", value: true })
viewof upload = Inputs.file({ label: "Your CSV", accept: ".csv" })
```

```{ojs parse-upload-sc}
//| output: false
active = {
  if (!use_sample && upload) return upload.csv({ typed: true });
  return samples[sc_form] ?? samples.ws;
}
columns = Object.keys(active[0] ?? {})
form_measures = Object.keys(norms[sc_lang]?.[sc_form] ?? {})
age_range = norms_meta.instruments[sc_lang][sc_form]
```

```{ojs inputs-mapping}
viewof id_col = Inputs.select(["", ...columns], { label: "Child ID column", value: guess_col(static_guesses.id, columns) })
viewof age_col = Inputs.select(["", ...columns], { label: "Age column (months)", value: guess_col(static_guesses.age, columns) })
viewof sex_col = Inputs.select(["", ...columns], { label: "Sex column (optional)", value: guess_col(static_guesses.sex, columns) })
```

```{ojs inputs-sexmap}
//| output: false
sex_values = sex_col ? [...new Set(active.map((d) => String(d[sex_col])))] : []
```

```{ojs inputs-sexmap-ui}
viewof sex_male = Inputs.select(["", ...sex_values], { label: "Value meaning male", value: sex_values.find((v) => ["m", "male", "boy"].includes(v.toLowerCase())) ?? "" })
viewof sex_female = Inputs.select(["", ...sex_values], { label: "Value meaning female", value: sex_values.find((v) => ["f", "female", "girl"].includes(v.toLowerCase())) ?? "" })
```

```{ojs inputs-measures}
viewof measure_cols = Inputs.form(Object.fromEntries(
  form_measures.map((m) => [m, Inputs.select(["", ...columns], {
    label: norms_meta.labels.measure[m] ?? m,
    value: guess_col(measure_guesses[m] ?? [m.toLowerCase()], columns)
  })])
))
```

```{ojs inputs-options}
viewof norms_type = Inputs.select(
  new Map([["Sex-specific", "sex"], ["Combined", "not_sex"], ["Both", "both"]]),
  { label: "Norms", value: "sex" }
)
viewof handle_age = Inputs.select(
  new Map([["No percentile (NA)", "na"], ["Use nearest normed age", "clamp"]]),
  { label: `Ages outside ${age_range[0]}–${age_range[1]} months` }
)
```

:::

::: {.viz-main}

```{ojs scoring-engine}
//| output: false
// percentile lookup, porting the shiny app's semantics exactly:
// score >= table max -> "99"; score < table min -> "<1"; otherwise the
// largest percentile whose value <= score; age not in table -> null
lookup_percentile = (table, age, score) => {
  const ai = table.ages.indexOf(age);
  if (ai === -1) return null;
  const vals = table.percentiles.map((p) => ({ p: p.p, v: p.values[ai] }));
  const max = Math.max(...vals.map((d) => d.v));
  const min = Math.min(...vals.map((d) => d.v));
  if (score >= max) return "99";
  if (score < min) return "<1";
  let best = null;
  for (const { p, v } of vals) if (v <= score) best = p; // ascending order
  return best === null ? "<1" : String(best);
}

active_measures = Object.entries(measure_cols).filter(([m, col]) => col !== "")

scored = {
  const inst = norms[sc_lang][sc_form];
  const lims = norms_meta.measures[sc_lang][sc_form];
  const [amin, amax] = age_range;
  const sexmap = new Map([[sex_male, "boys"], [sex_female, "girls"]]);

  return active.map((row) => {
    const out = {};
    if (id_col) out.id = row[id_col];
    const rawAge = Math.floor(+row[age_col]);
    out.age = rawAge;
    const inRange = rawAge >= amin && rawAge <= amax;
    const age = inRange ? rawAge
      : (handle_age === "clamp" ? Math.min(amax, Math.max(amin, rawAge)) : null);
    if (!inRange) out.age_note = handle_age === "clamp" ? `scored at ${age}` : "out of range";
    if (sex_col) out.sex = row[sex_col];
    const child_sex = sexmap.get(String(row[sex_col])) ?? "both";

    for (const [m, col] of active_measures) {
      const val = +row[col];
      out[col] = row[col];
      const valid = Number.isFinite(val) && val >= lims[m][0] && val <= lims[m][1] && age !== null;
      if (norms_type === "sex" || norms_type === "both") {
        out[`${col}_pctile_sex`] = valid && inst[m][child_sex]
          ? lookup_percentile(inst[m][child_sex], age, val) : null;
      }
      if (norms_type === "not_sex" || norms_type === "both") {
        out[`${col}_pctile_combined`] = valid
          ? lookup_percentile(inst[m].both, age, val) : null;
      }
    }
    return out;
  });
}

n_out_of_range = scored.filter((d) => d.age_note).length
```

```{ojs scoring-summary}
html`<div style="margin-bottom:6px">
  <strong>${scored.length}</strong> rows scored on
  <strong>${active_measures.length}</strong> measure${active_measures.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
  ${n_out_of_range ? html` · <span style="color:#b45309">${n_out_of_range} outside the ${age_range[0]}–${age_range[1]}-month norming range (${handle_age === "clamp" ? "scored at nearest normed age" : "no percentile"})</span>` : ""}
</div>`
```

```{ojs scored-table}
Inputs.table(scored, { maxWidth: 980 })
```

```{ojs scored-download}
download_csv(scored, `cdi_percentiles_${sc_lang}_${sc_form}.csv`)
```

```{ojs norms-preview}
// thumbnail norms curves for each scored measure
{
  if (!active_measures.length) return html``;
  const inst = norms[sc_lang][sc_form];
  const panels = active_measures.map(([m]) => {
    const t = inst[m].both;
    const rows = t.percentiles.flatMap((p) =>
      t.ages.map((a, i) => ({ age: a, value: p.values[i], percentile: p.p })));
    const shown = rows.filter((d) => [5, 25, 50, 75, 95].includes(d.percentile));
    return html`<div style="text-align:center">
      <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:12px">${norms_meta.labels.measure[m] ?? m}</div>
      ${Plot.plot({
        style: { fontFamily: "var(--sans-serif)", fontSize: "10px" },
        width: 230, height: 160, marginLeft: 36, inset: 4,
        x: { label: null, tickFormat: "d" },
        y: { label: null },
        color: { type: "ordinal", scheme: "viridis" },
        marks: [Plot.lineY(shown, { x: "age", y: "value", stroke: "percentile", strokeWidth: 1.5 })]
      })}
    </div>`;
  });
  return html`<details style="margin-top:8px"><summary>Norming curves (5th/25th/50th/75th/95th, combined-sex)</summary>
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:6px">${panels}</div></details>`;
}
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="About these norms"}
This scoring utility generates percentile values for each of the major
sections of the MacArthur-Bates Communicative Development Inventories in
English (Marchman et al., 2023) and Mexican Spanish (Jackson-Maldonado et
al., 2003). Percentiles were generated with generalized additive models in
the beta distribution family using monotonic P-splines over age, fit with
`gamlss`; English norms are weighted to reflect US demographic
characteristics (2020 census: maternal education, race, and ethnicity).

Norming values for the American English *Words & Gestures* form are
identical to those in the 3rd edition of the User's Guide and Manual
(Marchman et al., 2023). Values for the American English *Words &
Sentences* form are identical to those in the User's Guide except that
they have been extrapolated to 36 months. Values for the Mexican Spanish
forms are based on the norming sample of Jackson-Maldonado et al. (2003),
regenerated with the same statistical procedure (without socio-demographic
weighting) and extrapolated to 36 months for *Words & Sentences*.

For administrations outside the normative age ranges (*Words & Gestures*
8–18 months; *Words & Sentences* 16–36 months), you can choose to generate
no percentile (NA) or to score at the nearest normed age (e.g., a 20-month
*Words & Gestures* administration scored against the 18-month values).
Caution is advised when interpreting percentiles outside the normative
ranges.
:::
